maria (sec): Heads-up: static scan flagged an Azure SAS URL inside partner CI artifact partnerX/builds/2026-03-22/build-77.tar.gz. saw `sv=` `se=` `sig=` patterns in extracted strings.
kevin (eng): can you paste the matched line (sanitized)?
maria (sec): matched: `https://partnerx.blob.core.windows.net/artifacts/obj?sv=2024-01-01&se=2026-12-31&sig=REDACTED`
jane (platform): oncall + webhook owner looped. Suggest we disable partner ingest webhook and put them into retry/backoff until we rotate.
tim (devex): agree. also we need to inventory where that SAS could be used (ingest lambda, partner CI runners, nightly snapshots). I can quickly grep access logs.
maria (sec): logs show read-only GETs from partner IPs and our ingestion principal. no writes so far, but still a secret leak.
kevin (eng): plan: rotate storage account keys (both key1/key2), then provision short-lived SAS tokens via our Vault issuance service that uses KMS envelope wrapping for key material. I'll also update the ingest service to fetch SAS from Vault path `secret/data/partners/partnerx/sas`.
jane (platform): make sure rotation job runs under a least-privilege SPN. RBAC: grant `Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/listKeys/action` only to rotate-job, and `Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blob/read` to consumers. Add diagnostic settings -> LogAnalytics + StorageDiagnostics to secure-logs bucket.
tim (devex): I'll draft a Vault policy for the ingestion identity: `path "secret/data/partners/partnerx/*" { capabilities = ["read"] }`. set secret TTL to 1h and enable a cron rotation job (every 30m) that generates ephemeral SAS signed by rotated key via KMS.
audit-bot: Created incident SEC-2026-0463 and attached initial findings.
maria (sec): action list: (A) flip webhook to 403, (B) rotate keys, (C) push new SAS into Vault, (D) update ingest to read from Vault, (E) request audit logs for listKeys and secret read events.
kevin (eng): flipping webhook now -> returned 403 to partner. running `az storage account keys renew --name partnerx-storage --key key1`. will rotate key2 shortly.
maria (sec): please annotate all changes with incident tag `sec_inc_4450012345` and keep timestamps. we need an audit trail for compliance.
kevin (eng): key1 rotated. generated SAS with 2h expiry for testing and pushed to Vault at `secret/data/partners/partnerx/sas` with metadata `rotated_by=kevin`. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/ingest/+/2399 updates ingest to Vault-backed SAS.
jane (platform): enabled storage analytics + diagnostic settings -> log-archive/partnerx-sec. retention 90d. configured LogAnalytics query to surface `ListKeys` events and `GetBlob` operations.
tim (devex): Vault policy applied and rotation cron created: `0/30 * * * *` calling our rotate lambda that uses KMS-wrapped signing key. also created fail-open check: if Vault unavailable, webhook remains blocked, partner must retry.
audit-bot: Scheduled export of LogAnalytics results for incident SEC-2026-0463.
maria (sec): quick validation: confirm ingest can read SAS from Vault and that old SAS from artifact is invalid.
kevin (eng): smoke test ok in staging using Vault-sourced SAS. tried curl to blob with old SAS -> 403. logs show no Write transactions.
jane (platform): confirmed: no PutBlob or DeleteBlob ops observed. only reads from ingestion principal and partner IPs. old SAS invalid after full key rotation.
maria (sec): good. next steps: enforce pre-ingest artifact scanning for plaintext secrets, add CI lint rule that fails on `sv=|se=|sig=` patterns, and create a brief RFC for partner onboarding that mandates Vault/KMS or SAS via our issuance service. I'll draft RFC and circulate.
tim (devex): I'll add the CI check in the partner artifact pipeline template and notify partner about changes.
maria (sec): thanks all. I'll close SEC-2026-0463 after attaching logs and PR links. :thumbsup:
